column4: Begin exactly at the first frame: the black dental chair close up in the mustard operative hall. Turn and glide through the hall's side doorway into the private area, moving along a short warm corridor, ending exactly at the second frame: the yellow private cubicle with its round mirror, light wood cabinets and dental chair.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the grey stone treatment room with its two dental chairs. Leave the room and move toward the staircase to head back down, ending exactly at the second frame: the wooden stairwell beside the tall mirror door, steps leading downward.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the wooden stairwell beside the tall mirror door. Descend the stairs smoothly and drift out through the clinic entrance, emerging into the evening street, ending exactly at the second frame: the wide dusk view of the clinic facade with the Sonrisa sign — the journey ends where it began.
